item.title: Secret Military Projects, UFOs & Hidden Government Mysteries! (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Mack Maloney is a bestselling author and UFO researcher known for his popular fiction series, including Wingman, ChopperOps, Starhawk, and Pirate Hunters. He is also the author of UFOs in Wartime: What They Didn't Want You to Know, which explores reports of unidentified flying objects throughout military history. A native of Boston, Massachusetts, Maloney earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Journalism from Suffolk University and a Master of Arts degree in Film from Emerson College. Combining his storytelling talents with a fascination for military history, secret projects, and unexplained aerial phenomena, Maloney has built a career exploring the mysteries surrounding UFOs and the unknown.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
